title: Splinter Hollow
text: A basin inside a ring of green hills. Sheltered, watered, quiet. The convoy came in over the hills the hard way; there is an easier way in, from the east. It is the kind of place you'd choose if you wanted to be left alone.

lines.text: "Some of the Autonomists talk about a place like this. A hollow past the hills, where nobody's watching. I didn't think it was real."
